cases.expected: Header count for section 1 becomes 1; sections[1] is a non‑null List containing exactly the supplied ARecord.
cases.description: The target section is initially null. addRecord should allocate a new LinkedList, increment the header count, and store the record as the sole element.

cases.expected: Header count for section 2 becomes 3; sections[2] contains three records, the new ARecord being the last element.
cases.description: Section 2 already holds two records. Adding a third record must not replace the existing list, must increase the header count by one, and must append the new record.
Passing a negative section index should cause the underlying array access to throw an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.
Passing a section index larger than the internal sections array length (which is 4) should result in an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

cases.expected: Header count for section 0 increments by 1; sections[0] contains a single null element.
cases.description: The method does not guard against a null Record. Verify that it still creates the list (if needed), increments the header count, and stores the null reference.
The Message instance has its header field set to null (e.g., via setHeader(null)). When addRecord is invoked, the call to header.incCount(section) should throw a NullPointerException.
The internal sections array of the Message instance is null (e.g., the Message was constructed without initializing sections). Accessing sections[section] should result in a NullPointerException.
